# Advion Plugins

> Documentation and setup guides for Advion plugins.

- [Advion Plugins](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/index.md): Advion Plugins
- [UniversalStakes Wiki](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/readme.md): Start here: New to the plugin? Read Install the plugin, then follow Create your first stake. You do not need coding experience.

## UniversalStakes Wiki

- [Commands and Permissions](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/commands-and-permissions.md): By default, players have no UniversalStakes permissions. Give regular players universalstakes.use; give staff universalstakes.admin (operators receive it by default).
- [Create Your First Stake](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/first-stake.md): Goal: Create a one-hour diamond competition with one winner. This is the safest first configuration to test.
- [Database and Safety](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/database-and-safety.md): Before updating the plugin: Stop the server and back up the database. This is the one habit that prevents most data-loss problems.
- [Installation](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/installation.md): You need: Paper 1.21.7 (the verified server version), Java 21, the UniversalStakes release JAR, and outbound HTTPS for the first start. Do not use a JAR whose name contains SNAPSHOT on a live server.
- [Integrations](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/integrations.md): Use Vault only when: Players should deposit virtual money instead of items.
- [Menus](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/menus.md): Simple rule: Change text, icons, and lore first. Do not remove dynamic sections unless you intentionally want to remove their lists.
- [Rewards](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/rewards.md): Important: A reward command is run by the server console. Only trusted staff should be allowed to edit stake files.
- [Stake Settings Reference](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/stake-reference.md): Use this page when: You already have a stake file and want to understand one of its settings. For a copy-paste starter file, use Create Your First Stake.
- [Troubleshooting](https://deviaski.github.io/advion-docs/universalstakes/troubleshooting.md): Check that the file is in plugins/UniversalStakes/stakes/, ends in .yml, and has valid YAML indentation. Run /stakes admin reload to validate it and read the console, then perform a full server restart before expecting edits to an existing stake to apply.
